name: Morris County, NJ
findings: Morris County has 2,094 nonprofit organizations. 941 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 786 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Morris County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
